mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_knowledge_document WHERE deleted = 0 AND lease_owner IS NULL AND ( (status = 1 AND parse_status = 'PENDING') OR (status = 2 AND parse_status = 'DELETING') ) ORDER BY updated_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_knowledge_document SET parse_status = 'PARSING', lease_owner = #{workerId}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, error_message = NULL, updated_at = #{now}, version = COALESCE(version, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{documentId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND parse_status = 'PENDING' AND lease_owner IS NULL

UPDATE ai_knowledge_document SET lease_owner = #{workerId}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, error_message = NULL, updated_at = #{now}, version = COALESCE(version, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{documentId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 2 AND parse_status = 'DELETING' AND lease_owner IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_knowledge_document WHERE id = #{documentId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT * FROM ai_knowledge_document WHERE deleted = 0 AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < #{now} AND ( (status = 1 AND parse_status IN ('PARSING', 'CHUNKING', 'EMBEDDING', 'INDEXING')) OR (status = 2 AND parse_status = 'DELETING') ) ORDER BY lease_until ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_knowledge_document SET lease_owner = #{workerId}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, updated_at = #{now}, version = COALESCE(version, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{documentId} AND deleted = 0 AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < #{now} AND ( (status = 1 AND parse_status IN ('PARSING', 'CHUNKING', 'EMBEDDING', 'INDEXING')) OR (status = 2 AND parse_status = 'DELETING') )

UPDATE ai_knowledge_document SET parse_status = 'READY', status = 1, chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, token_count = #{tokenCount}, error_message = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now}, version = COALESCE(version, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{documentId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND lease_owner = #{workerId}

UPDATE ai_knowledge_document SET parse_status = 'DELETED', status = 2, deleted = 1, error_message = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now}, version = COALESCE(version, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{documentId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 2 AND parse_status = 'DELETING' AND lease_owner = #{workerId}

UPDATE ai_knowledge_document SET parse_status = 'FAILED', status = 1, chunk_count = 0, token_count = 0, error_message = #{message}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now}, version = COALESCE(version, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{documentId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND lease_owner = #{workerId}

UPDATE ai_knowledge_document SET parse_status = 'DELETE_FAILED', status = 2, error_message = #{message}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now}, version = COALESCE(version, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{documentId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 2 AND lease_owner = #{workerId}
